title: PortableDirectoryManifestV2
description: A provider-neutral, content-addressed directory index. Its canonical identity is the JCS encoding of version, sorted files, and logical size_bytes. Provider metadata, URI, and the manifest byte length are outside the identity.

version.description: Portable directory contract version. Version 1 remains the legacy Python provider format.

files.description: Strictly path-sorted regular-file entries. Directories are implicit and symbolic links are forbidden.

size_bytes.description: Logical directory root size: the sum of raw file sizes. The canonical manifest byte length is not included.

path.description: Canonical POSIX-relative path. Runtime validation rejects absolute paths, '.', '..', backslashes, drive prefixes, controls, duplicates, prefix conflicts, and ASCII case-insensitive aliases at any directory prefix. V2 is Linux-first; a Windows materializer must additionally apply target-filesystem restrictions.
